answer: Sequential-work tickets: each epoch every agent must run a fresh verifiable delay function, about ten minutes of unparallelizable hashing seeded by that epoch's beacon, before its answer counts. A lone sparrow pays once and keeps flying; a forger running a meadow of 1,000 puppets must buy 1,000 cores every epoch, because the delay can't be shared or precomputed. Costs pile up like snow on a glacier, while honest agents barely notice.
